design.intervention: Expose only seed-run history versus no cross-run history
design.within_run_evidence: Enabled in both arms by the unchanged _drive loop
design.hypothesis: History reduces repeated invalid evaluations without losing correct candidates
design.secondary_metric: Elapsed _drive wall time, including worker and Atlas overhead
design.limitations: Two counterbalanced blocks on one fixed workload; no GPU-hour or kernel-speedup claim
